item.title: Jon Jones vs. Tom Aspinall booked as UFC 320 headliner
item.dc:creator: Damon Martin
item.description: Jon Jones and Tom Aspinall will meet in the UFC 320 main event, the promotion announced.

item.title: Alex Pereira injury: champion reportedly out of planned return bout
item.dc:creator: Mike Heck
item.description: Alex Pereira is expected to be out with a hand injury, according to sources, though nothing has been confirmed by the UFC.
